# FMC Media PC 0.3.4

- Top 10 rows on Home, Movies, Series and Anime now fit all ten titles in a single row, including in a smaller window. Hover previews and title navigation remain available.
- Ranking 10 has its own space for both digits so its poster cannot hide the zero.
- Collections is now a main navigation destination directly below Discover. Browse saga artwork, movie counts, categories and TMDB collection search, then open the movies in release order.
- The Home Collections row opens the same catalogue. Collection loading failures offer Retry instead of silently removing the row; category filters wrap within the page.
